Also mine when not charging

Always-on mining is enabled. Running on battery, or ignoring heat, will flatten the battery quickly and keep the phone warm. Mining still stops if the phone reaches the point where Android would shut itself down — stopping one level early mines more than a shutdown and reboot would.
Permissions
All set — this phone can mine in the background.
Setup incomplete: mining will stop when the app is in the background or the screen is off. Grant everything listed below.
Battery usage: set to Unrestricted
Settings > Apps > PCoin Miner > Battery > Unrestricted. If this is set to Restricted, Android stops the miner in the background no matter what else is granted.
These are needed for mining to keep running when the app is in the background or the screen is off.
Grant
Open settings
Notifications: granted — the mining notification can be shown
Notifications: NOT granted — required, the miner cannot run as a foreground service without it
Battery optimisation: exempt — mining continues with the screen off
Battery optimisation: active — Android will suspend mining shortly after the screen goes off
Some phones (Samsung, Xiaomi, Oppo, Huawei) also need the app allowed in their own battery or auto-start settings. Android has no way for an app to request this, so it has to be set by hand.
Stop when hot
Mining pauses automatically once Android reports this heat level, and resumes when the phone cools. Choose Moderate for older phones.

Forward my coins

This app is a wallet. Mined coins are paid into it and stay here, recoverable with your twelve words, until you choose otherwise.

If you set an address below, the app will automatically send coins there once they are spendable. Everything the wallet holds is forwarded, not only mining rewards — so a payment someone sends you here would go on to that address too.

Before any real forwarding starts, the app sends a 1.00000000 PC test payment and waits for you to confirm you can see it. If you never confirm it, nothing more is ever sent.
